market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. September seasonality (56% decline history) combined with Warsh's hawkish Fed tone, US-Iran oil shock, and Buffett's warning create a risk-off backdrop. Expect 3-5% equity pullback in September. Oil remains volatile above $90. Gold under pressure from elevated yields. Fixed income offers 4.3% CD yields but rate-hike risk persists. EM outperformance continues but JPY intervention adds noise.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive with caution. AI infrastructure capex cycle remains intact despite IP litigation. EM and China dividend rotation offers 12-18 month upside. Lithium/battery storage structural demand supports commodity longs. Inflation persistence argues for TIPS and real assets. Index-fund discipline outperforms concentrated bets. Fed likely peaks rates by Q1 2027, supporting equities thereafter.
